items.title: David Friesen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 24, 2024
items.q: I was looking at the list of folks you’ve played with and I’m going to do a quick “saxophone player” list: John Handy, Sam Rivers, Michael Brecker, Joe Henderson, Johnny Griffin, Stan Getz, Dexter Gordon

ctx.x: Yeah. That’s right. In my situation when I became a — when I made a commitment to Christianity, to Christ, then there’s a Scripture that says, “I know my sheep and my sheep know my voice, and no man can pluck them out of my hand.” My life was following the Lord and so I could do choices I made I could make with confidence in my life. It wasn’t just half-assed, or, there was, Jesus is called the light of the world. So you know I don’t think of my faith as a feeling. When I think of feeling I think of a blind man…

Nice. I was looking at the list of folks you’ve played with and I’m going to do a quick “saxophone player” list: John Handy, Sam Rivers, Michael Brecker, Joe Henderson, Johnny Griffin, Stan Getz, Dexter Gordon and on and on. And being a saxophone player,

I’m wondering if these gentlemen asked for different things, or demanded different things from you as a bassist? Do you recall it being different playing with Johnny Griffin as it was for Stan Getz or — how did you adjust?
